name: Ecwid
verdict: Your app idea must be approved, then you pass App Market validation with a guide and screencast and sign a partner contract with revenue share. Ecwid billing is mandatory for some models; total time unknown.
needGuide: Yes — submit the app idea and sign the partner contract before building for outside stores.

auth.detail: Public apps use OAuth with client_id/client_secret issued after Ecwid approves your app idea; the token endpoint for public apps was changed from GET to POST in March 2025 and Store ID became required for external-app authentication in September 2025. Private (custom) apps are auto-created per account, use access tokens instead of an OAuth flow, and work only on the owner's store.

effort.timeToFirstTest: 30-60 min with the auto-created custom app and a paid-plan test store
effort.timeToProduction: 1-2 business days per submission step per the FAQ (ambiguous whether idea or validation); total unknown

approval.gate: App idea must be approved, then you build a dev version and pass App Market validation (guide plus a recorded screencast) before publication. You must sign a partner contract with revenue share, and Ecwid's billing is mandatory for supported monetization models. Changes to published apps need Ecwid approval.

scopes.why: Access scopes chosen in app settings (catalog, orders, customers…); exact names not confirmed.
scopes.summary: Apps request access scopes in app settings (catalog, orders, customers, store profile, etc.; exact names not confirmed). Custom apps default to products, categories, store profile read and orders. Apps that make little use of Ecwid APIs may be refused.

cost: Free to list; revenue share under the partner contract; developer needs a PayPal or bank account that accepts USD. API access needs a paid store plan (free upgrade for test stores on request).
prerequisites: Account and owner: A registered individual entrepreneur or corporate entity; AI-based apps require a registered corporate entity (not an individual). Company-owned Ecwid account.

Where you register: Submit the app idea form (description, merchant value, billing type, regions/platforms). After approval you get a dev app and a free Premium test store in the Ecwid admin app dashboard.
Cost: Free to list; revenue share under the partner contract; developer needs a PayPal or bank account that accepts USD. API access needs a paid store plan (free upgrade for test stores on request).

registerAt.path: Submit the app idea form (description, merchant value, billing type, regions/platforms). After approval you get a dev app and a free Premium test store in the Ecwid admin app dashboard.

steps.do: Submit the app idea at portal.ecwid.com app-market-request with value, billing type and regions
Prove entity status (entrepreneur or corporation) and set up a USD-capable payout account; sign the partner agreement
Choose Native or External app type and read app settings for client_id and secret
Implement OAuth for public apps (POST to token endpoint; include Store ID) and store tokens per store
Test in the free Premium test store with the dev app
Record the validation screencast and complete App Validation
Wire up Ecwid billing if charging, then publish to the App Market

roles.team: A registered individual entrepreneur or corporate entity; AI-based apps require a registered corporate entity (not an individual). Company-owned Ecwid account.
roles.console: none documented beyond the app dashboard; extra staging apps/stores available on request from API support.
roles.customer: The store owner or admin installs from the Ecwid App Market and accepts permissions. The store must be on a paid plan for API access.

testing: Ecwid provides a free Premium-plan test store and a dev app after idea approval; staging apps on request.

blockers.problem: AI-based apps need a corporate entity
Free-plan stores cannot use the API, which shrinks who can connect
Public OAuth details changed in 2025 (POST token request, Store ID required)
Excluded categories (unauthorized payment apps, POS integrations) are rejected at the idea stage

automation.agentCan: Draft the app idea submission and listing copy, write OAuth and token storage code, and script the screencast.
automation.humanMust: Submit via the portal, sign the partner contract, prove entity status, record the validation screencast, and handle billing setup.
